productCode.description: Sample bank product code. CC-prefixed products are credit cards; do not infer product type from the account name or balance sign.

balance.description: Current ledger balance at logicalTimeEpochMs. For CC-prefixed credit-card products, negative means an amount owed, zero means no current debt and positive means a credit balance. This is not the issued statement closing amount and does not prove whether its minimum payment has been paid.

limit.description: Modeled credit limit for a CC-prefixed credit-card product. Remaining modeled credit limit is max(0, limit - max(0, -balance)); it is not guaranteed purchasing authorization. Pending authorizations, holds and other restrictions are not included in this view.

currentMinPayment.description: Most recently calculated minimum payment. Use the selected issued statement minimumAmountDue and dueDate for that statement; this field does not prove payment settlement or predict future minimums.

closingAmount.description: Ledger balance when this statement closed. For a CC-prefixed credit-card account, a negative amount represents money owed. It may differ from the current account balance.

minimumAmountDue.description: Bank-recorded minimum amount for this issued statement and its dueDate. Preserve this recorded amount even if the current account balance differs; this view does not prove whether it was paid and does not provide future minimum-payment policy.

statements.description: Without statementPeriod, latest 12 statement records per customer (not a rolling 12-month filter); with statementPeriod, only statements whose end date falls in that month, selected from complete bank history. Both are oldest to newest by statement end date and bill ID. More than 100 matching statements fails rather than returning a partial month.

statementPeriod.description: Optional requested closing month (YYYY-MM, years 0001–9999), echoed only for a filtered partner API read. Statements are the complete matching set, at most 100; empty means no issued statement for that month.
